blocks.x: The first two weeks belong to the baseline. settlement and reconciliation friction gets a number, an owner and a signature; the quarter belongs to a bounded slice — interbank reconciliation network — live on your estate. Every artifact ships with its evidence — who signed the baseline, what the gate measured, where the number lives. For Banking & Financial Services, that discipline is not optional — it is the engagement model.

Regimes first, since they bind everything in Blockchain & Digital Trust delivery for Banking & Financial Services: DORA (EU) (ICT risk, incident reporting, resilience testing and third-party oversight obligations with supervisory scrutiny); Basel III endgame / capital regimes (model quality and data lineage directly affect RWA and capital); PSD2 / PSD3 and instant payments (real-time rails with fraud and SCA obligations). Evidence is generated by running the system, not assembled before a meeting.
The services behind Blockchain & Digital Trust for Banking & Financial Services, each page carrying the full build pattern:

items: Permissioned networks for multi-party truth — governance, consensus and integration done institutionally.
Instruments as tokens — issuance, custody and lifecycle under securities-law discipline.
Contracts as production software — specification, formal verification and audit before value moves.
Proof, not paperwork — EUDR, DPP and chain-of-custody systems regulators and customers can verify.
